description: Package load-order constraints, TeX engine selection rules, and template hygiene checks.

package_order_rules.reason: amsmath should generally be loaded before hyperref to avoid equation anchor and \eqref link issues.
cleveref MUST be loaded AFTER hyperref; loading hyperref after cleveref breaks \cref/\Cref formatting and links.
float/algorithm loaded before hyperref can trigger destination name warnings; load hyperref before algorithm when compatible.
